sentence: Hello!
Today,
I will tell you about my family.
My family lives in the United States.
My mother is 56 years old.
She is from Scotland,
but she moved to the United States when she was 20 years old.
She likes her life in America,
but she still loves Scottish food and music.
She is a kind and friendly person.
She works at a local supermarket and enjoys cooking for the family.
My father is American.
He was born in the United States,
but he doesn't live there anymore.
My parents are divorced,
and my father moved to France a few years ago.
He enjoys living in Europe and learning about French culture.
We don't see each other very often,
but we talk on the phone sometimes.
I have two sisters.
My older sister is 32 years old,
and her name is Emily.
She is a teacher at a local school.
My younger sister is 24 years old,
and her name is Olivia.
She works at a coffee shop and loves listening to music.
We are a close family,
and we enjoy spending time together.
I sometimes call them on weekends because I miss them a lot.
I also like sharing photos of my life in Norway with them.
Even though we live in different countries,
my family is always important to me!
